capabilities: extract IP addresses, domains, and SHA256/MD5 hashes from the current note
display all found IOCs in an organized sidebar view
defang domains and IP addresses via context menu or command
recognize standard and defanged IOCs like "evil[.]com"
open search pivots for an indicator on security engines
extras: Note contents are processed locally; the only automatic network request fetches the public TLD list from data.iana.org for domain validation, cached for offline use. Opening a search pivot sends the selected indicator to that provider.
motivation: As security professionals, the authors constantly encounter IOCs in their work and found tracking them within lengthy notes challenging.
problem: Security professionals struggle to keep track of indicators of compromise scattered throughout lengthy notes.
